sentences.3.3 Sompit skal besøke svigermor: 3.3 Sompit is going to visit her mother-in-law
sentences.Hawa og Sompit snakker sammen etter skol: Hawa and Sompit talk after school.
sentences.Hva skal du gjøre i dag, Sompit?: What are you going to do today, Sompit?
sentences.Nei, svigermor. Jeg har en mamma i Thail: No, my mother-in-law. I have a mum in Thailand and a mum in Norway.
I have to buy food, because she can't walk. Today I'm going to buy milk, bread and eggs for her.
sentences.Du er snill. Hva skal dere gjøre?: You're kind. What are you going to do?
sentences.Vi skal strikke. Svigermor strikker mye,: We're going to knit. My mother-in-law knits a lot, but I can't knit. I want to knit wool socks. It's cold in Norway.
Sompit is going to visit her mother-in-law.
She has to buy food for her.
sentences.Svigermor kan strikke, og Sompit vil lær: Her mother-in-law can knit, and Sompit wants to learn.
She wants to knit wool socks.
